title: Rev E unpowered loom, panel and STOP contact acceptance matrix
meaning_of_unpowered: No mains, motor, coil, USB, programmer, battery or other operating supply is connected. Stored energy is verified absent before removing/test connecting parts. A bounded resistance-meter stimulus is permitted; this is not literally zero electrical energy.

instrument_limits.rationale: Avoid turning on semiconductor junctions in populated-panel screens. Contact wetting, rated voltage and mechanical endurance require separate powered qualification.

exclusions: Mains dielectric/insulation resistance or protective-earth testing
Any measurements with installed mains capacitors or live CT assembly connected
Relay pickup/dropout, contactor interruption, watchdog/reset/latch operation
Powered key-transistor logic, I2C operation, OLED polarity under power
Firmware, EMC, sensor accuracy, motor dry-run protection or release approval
acceptance_policy: Every applicable case must pass; a failed case stops acceptance. Retest the complete affected cable/panel stage after rework. Never convert not_run to pass without an actual recorded measurement. All limits are assembly-screen criteria, not manufacturer or safety certification.

powered_key_test_deferred.note: Expected powered logic only, not measurable as logic while unpowered. With key enabled,11/00 invalid; internal MCP pullups disabled. No universal individual-wire-fault coverage is claimed.

stages.setup: Cable detached at both ends from every PCB, OLED and other equipment. Cavity numbers follow the connector drawing mating view; colours do not define function.
